stream_note: update stream length = n_items; the touched item is drawn UNIFORMLY WITH REPLACEMENT, so churn=f means f*n_items update events and an item may move several times; destination node is uniform over nodes that initially held items
space_note: or=6xuint32(176b,24B); count=176xuint16(352B, uint16 caps at 65535 items/bucket); epoch=176 bits + 176xuint32 stamps (728B)
op_note: one bucket-write: or=1, count=2 (dec old + inc new), epoch=1 stamp write (+ optional age sweep whose cost = current set bits, reported as epoch_sweep_bits_total); maint_ops_per_update_effective adds that sweep cost for epoch and equals maint_ops_per_update for or/count
query_note: candidate = subtree node whose bitmap has any predicate bucket set; probe_items_per_true = items in candidate nodes / truly matching items; epoch_cons passes stale bits (== or), epoch_aggr drops them (may miss truth)
